noteCourse.description: The course to file the note under, as a human course name or code. The adapter DERIVES the folder from it inside the school root and creates it if this is the course's first note — the caller never names a folder, so a note can only ever land under the school root.

noteTitle.description: The note's title. It becomes the H1 and the filename's readable part; the filename is date-prefixed by the adapter so a course folder sorts chronologically on its own.
